meta.name: budgeting-and-forecasting
meta.description: Runs the planning cycle — annual budget, rolling forecast, consolidation of business unit inputs, and the variance analysis that explains actuals against plan. Use this to build or challenge a budget, run a forecast cycle, consolidate departmental submissions, explain why results diverged from plan, or improve forecast accuracy.

copy.tagline: 制定年度预算与滚动预测,并分析实际与计划的差异
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要编制年度预算或滚动预测,并想解释实际与计划的偏差。
copy.tagline_en: Build annual budgets and rolling forecasts, and analyze variances against plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create annual budgets or rolling forecasts and explain deviations from plan.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你完成预算与预测的完整流程：设定目标和假设、按模板收集各部门提交、挑战输入、合并后找差距，并支持滚动预测和差异分析。
howto.when: 当你要求制定或质询预算、做滚动预测、解释实际与计划的差异等预算分析任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我制定明年的年度预算框架
say.note: 它会先设定目标、人数上限和关键假设。

say.text: 把各部门提交的预算合并起来，看看缺口在哪
say.note: 会找出自下而上和自上而下的差距，并建议削减哪些具体项目。

say.text: 解释一下这个季度实际数和预算数为什么有差异
say.note: 会分解为数量、单价、时机和组合因素，只解释金额最大的几项。

howto.what_en: Claude will run the planning cycle with you: set the frame (targets, headcount envelope, assumptions), collect inputs in a fixed template, challenge inputs, consolidate to find and close the gap, and support rolling forecast and variance analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build or challenge a budget, run a rolling forecast, explain actual-vs-plan variances, or similar budgeting tasks.

say_en.text: Help me set the annual budget framework for next year.
say_en.note: It will first set targets, headcount envelope, and key assumptions.

say_en.text: Consolidate departmental budget submissions and find the gap.
say_en.note: It will identify bottom-up vs top-down gaps and suggest specific cuts.

say_en.text: Explain why actuals differ from the budget for this quarter.
say_en.note: It decomposes into volume, rate, timing, and mix, focusing on top items.
